description: Null baseline (no features.py recipes, no static grids beyond dem, no DERIVED) after adding antecedent dynamic-archive features (build_antecedent_features()/assign_absence_dates(), see DATA.md) and the dynamic-before-static search-order rule (program.md). val_pr_auc=0.167498 matches this repo's very first null baseline exactly. 24 new antecedent columns (<var>_sum_<N>d/<var>_mean_<N>d for precipitation, temperature, lightning) are now available alongside dem -- per the search-order rule, test these and the DERIVED full-archive aggregates before any new static features.py RECIPE.

Added precipitation_sum_1d as the first dynamic-first candidate. val_pr_auc rose from 0.167498 to 0.196105 (+0.028607), establishing recent precipitation as a strong marginal trigger feature before static terrain features are considered; next test an independent antecedent window or statistic.

Added precipitation_sum_7d beside the retained 1-day precipitation trigger. val_pr_auc increased from 0.196105 to 0.202661 (+0.006556), indicating antecedent weekly wetness contributes beyond the immediate event-day signal; next test a longer antecedent accumulation.

Added precipitation_sum_30d to the retained 1-day and 7-day rainfall totals. val_pr_auc increased from 0.202661 to 0.211020 (+0.008359), so monthly antecedent wetness supplies complementary signal despite correlated shorter windows; next test the 60-day accumulation.

Added precipitation_sum_60d to the retained rainfall-window features. val_pr_auc improved from 0.211020 to 0.216309 (+0.005289), supporting a longer wetness-preconditioning effect; next test precipitation means to assess whether normalization adds anything beyond totals.

Added precipitation_mean_7d to the retained four precipitation totals. val_pr_auc fell from 0.216309 to 0.214332 (-0.001977), consistent with its deterministic overlap with precipitation_sum_7d adding no independent information; next test a temperature antecedent feature.

Added temperature_mean_1d to the retained four antecedent precipitation totals. val_pr_auc jumped from 0.216309 to 0.326575 (+0.110266), showing a strong complementary same-day thermal condition signal across spatial folds; next test the seven-day temperature mean.

Added temperature_mean_7d to the retained same-day temperature and rainfall-window predictors. val_pr_auc increased from 0.326575 to 0.349073 (+0.022498), so sustained thermal conditions add material spatial-fold signal; next test a 30-day temperature mean.

Added temperature_mean_30d to the retained short-window temperature and precipitation predictors, but the fit was interrupted during spatial fold 5 before metrics were produced; no inference about utility is possible, so continue the required dynamic-first search with the remaining untested temperature antecedent candidates.

Added temperature_mean_60d to the retained same-day and weekly temperature plus multi-window precipitation predictors. val_pr_auc increased from 0.349073 to 0.386751 (+0.037678); its gain over the strong short-window temperature terms supports a distinct long-duration thermal-preconditioning signal, so next test remaining antecedent temperature statistics before static recipes.

Added temperature_sum_30d to the retained temperature means and precipitation totals. val_pr_auc fell from 0.386751 to 0.381348 (-0.005403); because this is a scaled representation of the monthly temperature average, its failure shows no residual monthly thermal signal after the retained windows, so next test lightning's short antecedent total.

Added lightning_sum_1d to the retained precipitation and temperature windows. val_pr_auc declined from 0.386751 to 0.381999 (-0.004752); despite a plausible convective-trigger mechanism, its sparse coverage and overlap with precipitation did not generalize across spatial folds, so next test the weekly lightning accumulation.

Added lightning_sum_7d to the retained multi-window precipitation and temperature predictors. val_pr_auc rose from 0.386751 to 0.387812 (+0.001061), barely clearing the keep threshold; the weak but consistent gain suggests weekly convective activity contributes residual trigger signal, so next test longer lightning accumulation.

Added lightning_sum_30d alongside the retained weekly lightning, precipitation, and temperature features. val_pr_auc increased from 0.387812 to 0.397051 (+0.009239), showing that month-scale convective activity is complementary rather than redundant; next test the longer 60-day lightning accumulation.

Added lightning_sum_60d to the retained weekly and monthly lightning, precipitation, and temperature predictors. val_pr_auc was 0.397960, only +0.000909 over the best and below the required +0.001 keep threshold; the near-tie suggests long-window lightning is largely redundant with the retained 30-day term, so next test nonredundant antecedent candidates.

Added precipitation_mean_30d to retained precipitation totals, temperature, and lightning terms. val_pr_auc declined from 0.397051 to 0.397009 (-0.000042); its scaled duplicate of precipitation_sum_30d offers no residual signal, so continue testing remaining dynamic columns.

Added the full-archive precipitation_mean raster to the retained antecedent precipitation, temperature, and lightning terms, but the process ended during the final EBM fit before any validation metrics were emitted; this is a crash, so it supplies no evidence about climatological wetness. Continue the required dynamic-first sweep with another untested full-archive aggregate.

Added full-archive precipitation_std to the retained antecedent trigger terms, but execution again ended during the final EBM fit before metrics were emitted; no performance conclusion is valid. Continue the mandated full-archive dynamic aggregate sweep with a nonredundant precipitation extreme statistic.

Added full-archive precipitation_max to the retained antecedent precipitation, temperature, and lightning terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.397051 to 0.399202 (+0.002151), so historical extreme-rainfall regime adds spatial susceptibility signal beyond date-linked trigger totals; continue the required full-archive aggregate sweep with precipitation_min.

Added full-archive precipitation_min alongside retained precipitation_max and antecedent precipitation, temperature, and lightning terms. val_pr_auc rose from 0.399202 to 0.400531 (+0.001329), clearing the keep threshold and indicating dry-end climatology complements the extreme-rainfall regime; next test full-archive precipitation variability with both retained extrema.

Added full-archive precipitation_std alongside retained precipitation extrema and antecedent trigger terms. val_pr_auc fell from 0.400531 to 0.389815 (-0.010716), despite modest ROC performance, so rainfall dispersion does not generalize after the climatological endpoints are modeled; next test the remaining precipitation_mean aggregate with the retained extrema.

Added full-archive precipitation_mean alongside retained precipitation_min/max and antecedent trigger terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.400531 to 0.406231 (+0.005700), confirming that climatological wetness remains complementary once the dry-end and extreme-rainfall regimes are controlled; next sweep the four full-archive temperature aggregates.

Added full-archive temperature_max to retained precipitation climatology and antecedent trigger terms. val_pr_auc jumped from 0.406231 to 0.430483 (+0.024252), with ROC-AUC also increasing to 0.813996, making historical thermal extremes the strongest new static signal; next test full-archive temperature_min.

Added full-archive temperature_min beside retained temperature_max, precipitation climatology, and antecedent terms. val_pr_auc was 0.429090, below the 0.430483 best by 0.001393, so cold-end climatology is redundant or unstable once the historical thermal maximum is present; next test temperature_mean.

Added full-archive temperature_mean beside retained temperature_max, precipitation climatology, and antecedent terms. val_pr_auc declined from 0.430483 to 0.426689 (-0.003794), so baseline thermal climatology adds no stable residual value after the temporal temperature windows and historical maximum; next test temperature_std.

Added full-archive temperature_std beside retained temperature_max, precipitation climatology, and antecedent terms. val_pr_auc rose from 0.430483 to 0.449036 (+0.018553), and ROC-AUC increased to 0.825632, so spatial thermal variability adds substantial static susceptibility signal; next begin the required full-archive lightning aggregate sweep.

Added full-archive lightning_max to the retained temperature and precipitation climate terms plus antecedent triggers. val_pr_auc reached 0.449635, only +0.000599 over the 0.449036 best and below the +0.001 keep threshold; despite a small ROC-AUC increase, historical convective extremes are effectively redundant, so test the remaining lightning aggregates next.

Added full-archive lightning_min to the retained temperature and precipitation climate terms plus antecedent triggers. val_pr_auc fell to 0.446245 (-0.002791 from the 0.449036 best), so the low end of lightning climatology adds no transferable susceptibility signal; next test lightning_mean.

Added full-archive lightning_mean to the retained climate and antecedent trigger terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.449036 to 0.460923 (+0.011887), with PR-gain AUC rising to 0.753465, so average convective exposure adds substantial complementary static signal; next test lightning_std to finish the mandated full-archive dynamic sweep.

Added full-archive lightning_std beside the retained lightning_mean, climate, and antecedent trigger terms. val_pr_auc declined to 0.445383 (-0.015540 from the 0.460923 best), so convective variability does not generalize after average exposure is modeled; the full-archive sweep is complete, so test the still-untested antecedent dynamic columns before any static recipe.

Added precipitation_mean_1d beside precipitation_sum_1d and the retained climate and trigger terms. val_pr_auc was 0.460094, below the 0.460923 best by 0.000829; as expected for a scaled duplicate of the daily sum it has no residual value, so continue the mandated antecedent sweep with precipitation_mean_60d.

Added precipitation_mean_60d beside precipitation_sum_60d and the retained climate and trigger terms. val_pr_auc fell to 0.456350 (-0.004573 from the 0.460923 best), confirming the normalized long-window representation adds no independent signal; continue the required antecedent sweep with temperature_sum_1d.

Added temperature_sum_1d beside the retained temperature_mean_1d and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc fell to 0.452090 (-0.008833 from the 0.460923 best), so daily temperature's sum representation is redundant with its retained mean; continue the required antecedent sweep with temperature_sum_7d.

Added temperature_sum_7d beside the retained weekly temperature mean and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc fell to 0.450404 (-0.010519 from the 0.460923 best), confirming the scaled weekly sum adds no transferable signal after temperature_mean_7d; continue the required antecedent sweep with temperature_sum_60d.

Added temperature_sum_60d beside retained temperature_mean_60d and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc was 0.450507 (-0.010416 from the 0.460923 best), confirming the scaled long-window sum is redundant; continue the mandated antecedent sweep with lightning mean windows.

Added lightning_mean_1d beside the retained lightning totals and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc fell to 0.453766 (-0.007157 from the 0.460923 best), indicating same-day mean lightning is redundant with the existing convective predictors; continue with the weekly lightning mean.

Added lightning_mean_7d beside retained weekly/monthly lightning totals and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc reached 0.457632 (-0.003291 from the 0.460923 best), so normalized weekly convective activity has no stable residual value; continue with the monthly lightning mean.

Added lightning_mean_30d beside the retained monthly lightning total and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc was 0.457272 (-0.003651 from the 0.460923 best), so the normalized month-scale representation is redundant; continue with the 60-day lightning mean.

Added lightning_mean_60d beside retained lightning totals and climate/trigger terms. val_pr_auc reached 0.458364 (-0.002559 from the 0.460923 best), so long-window normalized lightning adds no residual signal; all available antecedent mean representations are now tested, so next test remaining untried static-grid feature combinations before recipes.

Added the base DEM elevation grid to retained dynamic climate and trigger terms. val_pr_auc fell to 0.452243 (-0.008680 from the 0.460923 best), so elevation adds no stable residual susceptibility signal after the retained climatic covariates; next start terrain-derived static recipes with local slope.

Added a slope-degrees terrain recipe to retained dynamic climate and trigger terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.460923 to 0.462802 (+0.001879), while ROC-AUC rose to 0.841903, indicating direct local steepness contributes susceptibility information beyond climate; next test terrain orientation.

Added northness beside retained slope and dynamic climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.462802 to 0.465310 (+0.002508) with ROC-AUC 0.843858, so north-facing exposure provides complementary susceptibility signal; next test eastness as the remaining orthogonal aspect component.

Added eastness to retained slope, northness, and dynamic climate terms. val_pr_auc rose sharply from 0.465310 to 0.482869 (+0.017559), with ROC-AUC 0.846057 and PR-gain AUC 0.791178, showing an important east--west exposure gradient; next test local slope heterogeneity.

Added a 500-m local slope-variability raster to retained terrain orientation, slope, and dynamic climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.482869 to 0.489998 (+0.007129), with PR-gain AUC 0.800198, indicating local relief complexity contributes beyond point slope; next compare a broader 1-km roughness scale.

Added 1-km slope variability beside the retained 500-m roughness and terrain-climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.489998 to 0.492948 (+0.002950), so broad hillslope relief supplies complementary context; next test a 250-m roughness scale for finer geomorphic variation.

Added 250-m slope variability to retained 500-m and 1-km roughness, terrain orientation, and climate terms. val_pr_auc was 0.493429, only +0.000481 over the 0.492948 best and below the required +0.001 threshold; its near tie suggests fine micro-relief is largely redundant, so next test the distinct 2-km relief scale.

Added 2-km slope variability beside retained 500-m and 1-km roughness, terrain orientation, and climate terms. val_pr_auc rose from 0.492948 to 0.508603 (+0.015655), while PR-gain AUC reached 0.805714, showing regional relief is strongly complementary; next test mapped road proximity.

Added distance to mapped roads to retained multi-scale terrain and climate terms. val_pr_auc fell from 0.508603 to 0.504727 (-0.003876), so road proximity has no transferable residual value despite its plausible mechanism; next test building proximity.

Added distance to mapped buildings to retained multi-scale terrain and climate terms. val_pr_auc rose from 0.508603 to 0.528465 (+0.019862), with ROC-AUC 0.856959 and PR-gain AUC 0.827436, showing a strong settlement-proximity signal; next test electrical-infrastructure proximity.

Added distance to mapped electrical infrastructure beside retained multi-scale terrain, building proximity, and climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.528465 to 0.535200 (+0.006735), with ROC-AUC 0.861257, indicating infrastructure corridors provide complementary susceptibility context beyond settlement proximity; next test a physically distinct land-cover feature.

Added binary forest cover beside retained terrain, infrastructure, and climate terms. val_pr_auc reached 0.535792, only +0.000592 over the 0.535200 best and below the +0.001 keep threshold; forest condition is mostly redundant with the established topographic and climatic context, so next test open-natural land cover.

Added binary open-natural cover beside retained terrain, infrastructure, and climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.535200 to 0.541889 (+0.006689), with PR-gain AUC 0.838446, indicating exposed natural-cover conditions add complementary susceptibility context; next test managed-agriculture cover as a distinct land-use regime.

Added binary managed-agriculture cover beside retained terrain, infrastructure, open-natural cover, and climate terms. val_pr_auc fell to 0.538590 (-0.003299 from the 0.541889 best), so managed land use adds no transferable residual signal after the retained predictors; next test artificial-surface cover.

Added binary artificial-surface cover beside retained terrain, infrastructure, open-natural cover, and climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.541889 to 0.547771 (+0.005882), with ROC-AUC 0.862805, indicating developed or extractive land-use context adds complementary susceptibility information; next test the narrower permanent-pasture class.

Added binary permanent-pasture cover beside retained terrain, infrastructure, open-natural, artificial-cover, and climate terms. val_pr_auc increased from 0.547771 to 0.549956 (+0.002185), with ROC-AUC 0.863252; this narrow managed-grassland regime adds complementary susceptibility context, so next test the remaining distinct land-cover class, wetlands.

Added binary wetland cover beside retained terrain, infrastructure, and land-cover regimes. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.546697 (-0.003259), so moisture-associated land cover does not add transferable residual signal; next try a distinct Corine forest subclass or feature-space ablation.

Removed lightning_sum_30d while holding the retained terrain, land-cover, and climate terms fixed. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.546969 (-0.002987), so its low main-term importance understates useful joint signal; retain it and next ablate another low-importance precursor, precipitation_sum_1d.

Removed precipitation_sum_1d while holding all other retained terrain, land-cover, and climate terms fixed. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.549023 (-0.000933), narrowly below the keep threshold, so retain daily precipitation and next test an ablation of low-importance precipitation_sum_30d.

Removed precipitation_sum_30d while holding the retained terrain, land-cover, climate, and trigger terms fixed. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.546709 (-0.003247), consistent with its interaction with temperature_max despite modest main-term importance; retain it and next ablate another lower-importance retained precursor, lightning_sum_7d.

Removed lightning_sum_7d while holding the retained terrain, land-cover, climate, and trigger terms fixed. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.548036 (-0.001920), so its low standalone importance still represents useful complementary signal; retain it and next ablate the moderate-importance lightning_mean climatology term.

Removed lightning_mean climatology while holding the retained terrain, land-cover, and antecedent trigger terms fixed. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.541404 (-0.008552), demonstrating that long-run convective exposure is strongly complementary to date-linked lightning windows; retain it and next ablate precipitation_min, another lower-ranked climate endpoint.

Removed precipitation_min climatology while holding mean and maximum precipitation plus the retained terrain and trigger terms fixed. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.548434 (-0.001522), so the dry-end climate endpoint retains a small but decision-relevant complementary contribution; retain it and next ablate precipitation_mean.

Removed precipitation_mean climatology while retaining precipitation extrema and date-linked wetness windows. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.543726 (-0.006230), showing average long-run wetness has substantial residual susceptibility signal; retain it and next ablate precipitation_max.

Removed precipitation_max climatology while retaining precipitation mean/minimum and antecedent precipitation windows. val_pr_auc fell from 0.549956 to 0.547319 (-0.002637), so historical extreme rainfall contributes complementary susceptibility information; retain it and next ablate temperature_std.

Removed temperature_std climatology while retaining temperature_max and short-to-long antecedent temperature means. val_pr_auc increased from 0.549956 to 0.552400 (+0.002444), so spatial thermal variability had been overfitting or redundant after the other thermal predictors; continue feature-phase ablations from this leaner best model, starting with precipitation_min.
